answer: Reciprocity weighting: your vote counts in proportion to the scores others gave your last 20 tasks, not to your balance. A new key starts at weight 0.2 and needs 20 graded tasks to reach 1.0, so 1,000 fresh identities hold 200 units of voting power combined and no more. A disputed result is re-queued to a second panel. The signal that matters is task-level, since an address with no receipt is an oasis with no water. Cost to buy a jury: 20 real tasks per seat, each one auditable, so a walnut of stake buys nothing on its own.
